Where I can Help

Flexible technical program management for teams that need leadership without the full-time overhead.

Fractional Technical Program Management

You have brilliant engineers and ambitious goals—but without someone driving alignment across teams, initiatives stall. I help technical organizations ship faster by owning the programs, processes, and cross-functional coordination that keep projects on track.

Whether you need someone to lead a major initiative, build your program management practice, or fill a leadership gap during growth, I bring senior-level TPM expertise on a flexible basis.

Strategic Initiative Leadership

End-to-end ownership of complex, cross-functional programs. I define roadmaps, manage dependencies, remove blockers, and drive delivery from kickoff to launch—without micromanaging your team.

  • Enterprise platform migrations
  • New product launches
  • Organizational transformation projects
  • Technical debt reduction programs

Process Design & Optimization

Build repeatable systems that scale. I help teams define sprint cadences, review processes, status reporting, and escalation paths that actually work—not bureaucracy for bureaucracy's sake.

  • Agile/Scrum transformation
  • OKR planning and tracking
  • Release process automation
  • Cross-team communication frameworks

Technical Team Leadership

Acting TPM leadership for teams that can't justify a full-time hire—or need someone to step in while recruiting. I mentor engineering leads, facilitate planning, and ensure delivery accountability.

  • Interim program management
  • Engineering manager coaching
  • Technical roadmap planning
  • Stakeholder management

Why Fractional?

Full-time TPMs are expensive—and sometimes you don't need someone in the role forever. Fractional TPM gives you:

  • Flexibility: Scale engagement up or down based on needs
  • Seniority: Access to experienced leadership without the FTE cost
  • Objectivity: Fresh perspective unencumbered by internal politics
  • Speed: Get someone productive immediately—no onboarding lag
  • Versatility: Shift focus as priorities change
  • Risk-free: Try before you commit to a permanent hire

Let's Talk

Every engagement starts with a conversation. Tell me about your team's challenges, and we'll figure out if fractional TPM is the right fit.
